messages:
Alex Rivera: opened a small PR to clarify the error-ref examples for 429s + timeouts. Found that our streaming example suggests parsing partial JSON which is risky. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8722
Maria Gomez: thanks Alex. Can you keep both a curl repro and a short SDK v2 snippet? People copy-paste the latter a lot.
Alex Rivera: yes. plan: curl repro to show stream->429, then Python snippet showing `retry_policy` + prefix trim.
Sam Patel: CI linted `samples/errref/streaming.md` for a bad anchor. I'll update to `#stream-429-handling` and fix markdownlint.
Ivy Nakamura: note for the docs: add a tiny decision table under "When to resume vs fallback". Resume only if operation is idempotent and you have resume tokens; otherwise fallback to a shorter prompt or different model variant.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8722  build queued
Alex Rivera: curl repro I'm proposing:
Alex Rivera: ```bash
# start a stream then kill the socket to simulate network interruption
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-light-1","input":"<very long prompt>"}'
# sometimes server will later return a 429 after partial tokens
```
Ivy Nakamura: nice. For the Python snippet show `resp.stream()` usage and catching `StreamError` with `e.status_code == 429`. Recommend trimming to last 2048 tokens before retry.
Alex Rivera: pushed changes: added trim helper, added `max_retries: 3` with exponential backoff snippet. Left a short note about checking response metadata for `truncated` flag to detect server-side context clipping.
Sam Patel: fixed anchor, re-ran CI  build passed :white_check_mark:
Maria Gomez: can someone run the curl repro in staging to confirm the behaviour? If reproducible, I'll merge and add release note: "Docs: clearer streaming 429 guidance + SDK examples".
Ivy Nakamura: ran it in staging, reproduced stream->429. Added a line advising preferring prefix caching where possible to reduce retries.
Alex Rivera: merging after squash. Thanks all :tada:
Maria Gomez: closing thread.
